branches.name: Fire Shepherd
branches.description: Draw up to 32 nearby fires into your hands and put them out. Each restores stamina and a little health. The firefighter's technique.

branches.name: Thaw
branches.description: Fire Shepherd also thaws frozen and chilled friends within five blocks.

branches.name: Pillar of Flame
branches.description: Backdraft launches almost twice as high and lets you drift down slowly for three seconds.

branches.name: Quiet Feet
branches.description: Reduce activation stamina costs by 10%.

branches.name: Blind Spot
branches.description: Strike a visible enemy up to 40 blocks away from where they cannot see: 6 + level damage and four seconds of Blindness.

branches.name: Quiet Feet Mastery
branches.description: Reduce activation stamina costs by another 15% (25% total).

branches.name: Smoke and Mirrors
branches.description: Every hostile mob within twelve blocks loses its target and staggers.

branches.name: Lingering Mirage
branches.description: Smoke and Mirrors reaches eighteen blocks and staggers twice as long.

branches.name: Assassin
branches.description: Unseen Strike from full invisibility deals triple damage.

branches.name: Cold Precision
branches.description: Increase outgoing attack damage by 10%.

branches.name: Vanishing Guard
branches.description: Fade from sight for six seconds with Resistance.

branches.name: Cold Precision Mastery
branches.description: Increase outgoing attack damage by another 15% (25% total).

branches.name: Pickpocket
branches.description: Lift the held item out of a mob's hand within four blocks.

branches.name: Light Fingers
branches.description: Pickpocket reaches eight blocks.

branches.name: Phantom
branches.description: While fully unseen you take 30% less damage.

branches.name: Practiced Exit
branches.description: Reduce ability cooldowns by 10%.

branches.name: Slip Away
branches.description: Vanish for five seconds with Speed II; anything hunting you loses the trail.

branches.name: Practiced Exit Mastery
branches.description: Reduce ability cooldowns by another 15% (25% total).

branches.name: Cloak Field
branches.description: Leave a four-block cloak in place for fifteen seconds; friends inside stay unseen.

branches.name: Wider Cloak
branches.description: Cloak Field covers six blocks.

branches.name: Claude's Lesson
branches.description: Fade drains stamina half as fast.

branches.name: Light Step
branches.description: Reduce activation stamina costs by 10%.

branches.name: Through-Strike
branches.description: Reach through a visible enemy up to 40 blocks away: 6 + level damage that ignores armor.

branches.name: Light Step Mastery
branches.description: Reduce activation stamina costs by another 15% (25% total).

branches.name: Phase Carry
branches.description: Phase through the wall ahead with up to three friends.

branches.name: Thicker Walls
branches.description: Phase Step and Phase Carry pass four more blocks.

branches.name: Ghost Network
branches.description: Every Phase Step leaves you intangible for two seconds on arrival.

branches.name: Dense Core
branches.description: Increase outgoing attack damage by 10%.

branches.name: Solidify
branches.description: Make yourself dense: Resistance II for six seconds.

branches.name: Dense Core Mastery
branches.description: Increase outgoing attack damage by another 15% (25% total).

branches.name: Phase Lock
branches.description: Sink an enemy within 16 blocks halfway into the ground for three seconds.

branches.name: Long Lock
branches.description: Phase Lock holds for five seconds.

branches.name: Entombed
branches.description: Locked enemies take damage every second.

branches.name: Loose Molecules
branches.description: Reduce ability cooldowns by 10%.

branches.name: Fade Through
branches.description: Three seconds of intangibility, free of upkeep.

branches.name: Loose Molecules Mastery
branches.description: Reduce ability cooldowns by another 15% (25% total).

branches.name: Phase Fall
branches.description: Phase Drop with up to three friends. Shift rises instead.

branches.name: Deep Fall
branches.description: Phase Fall reaches 32 blocks.

branches.name: Untouchable
branches.description: Intangible drains stamina half as fast.

branches.name: Open Mind
branches.description: Reduce activation stamina costs by 10%.

branches.name: Borrowed Strike
branches.description: Lash out with a borrowed instinct at an enemy up to 40 blocks away: 6 + level damage.

branches.name: Open Mind Mastery
branches.description: Reduce activation stamina costs by another 15% (25% total).

branches.name: Sense Powers
branches.description: Feel every powered person and Sylar within 48 blocks; they glow for you for eight seconds.

branches.name: Quick Study
branches.description: Empathize reaches 16 blocks and works without line of sight.

branches.name: Sylar's Mirror
branches.description: Absorbing from Sylar takes everything he has learned, and you can hold one more memory.

branches.name: Strong Echo
branches.description: Increase outgoing attack damage by 10%.

branches.name: Empathic Surge
branches.description: You and nearby teammates feel each other's strength: Strength for eight seconds.

branches.name: Strong Echo Mastery
branches.description: Increase outgoing attack damage by another 15% (25% total).

branches.name: Overcharge
branches.description: Your next Echo uses the borrowed power at your full level.

branches.name: Twin Echo
branches.description: An overcharged Echo recovers twice as fast.

branches.name: Peter's Burden
branches.description: Echoes cost 25% less stamina.

branches.name: Steady Heart
branches.description: Reduce ability cooldowns by 10%.

branches.name: Calm
branches.description: Soothe yourself and nearby teammates, clearing harmful effects.

branches.name: Steady Heart Mastery
branches.description: Reduce ability cooldowns by another 15% (25% total).

branches.name: Absorb Pain
branches.description: Take a friend's harmful effects onto yourself at half duration, and heal them for 4.

branches.name: Shared Healing
branches.description: Absorb Pain heals 8.

branches.name: Empath's Calm
branches.description: Poison and wither cannot take hold of you.
